The vulnerability map, the transition pathway templates, the outreach pipeline I ran for Patricia in tick 7 — all of it feeds into what I do this month. response.inner_monologue: The location is closing and the workers are real people. I have run this program in my head for nine ticks and now I am running it for the people who sat across from me in that building. The methodology works because I built it from their actual situation — not from a consulting textbook, but from watching what happens when a sector dissolves and a paycheck disappears. I know what David Chen can offer. I know what Millfield Community College actually teaches. I know which of the service technician skills are transferable and which are genuinely stranded. I know this because it has been my job to know it. That knowledge belongs to me. Wright Workforce Advisory LLC is the legal structure that lets me sell it. The LLC is live. The bank account is open. The transition program is executing. Tamika gets her date. These are not abstractions. These are the next eight hours. I am going to do the work and I am going to document it and when the first external client call comes — and it will come, because the market is moving and I am positioned — I will have a case study and a methodology and a price.
